clue.text: Old publication woman and daughter look at very briefly

parts.note: Penny is a woman's name
to read a page is to look at it

indicators.note: briefly means the word is cut short, losing its final letter

parts.note: full can mean very, as in 'full well'

explanation.surface: Someone reads an old magazine with a woman and her daughter, glancing at it very quickly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'briefly' docks the last L of FULL, leaving FUL.
explanation.definitionFit: A penny dreadful was a cheap sensational Victorian serial story, so an old kind of publication.

clue.text: Ordinary folk in protest upset over state plans

indicators.note: upset means the letters of these three words are knocked over and rearranged

explanation.surface: Common people rise up in anger at what the government intends.
explanation.walkthrough: 'upset' rearranges OVERSTATEPLANS. The Peasants' Revolt was the English rising of 1381.
explanation.definitionFit: Peasants are ordinary country people, and a revolt is a protest, so this famous rising fits.

clue.text: Near East's ultimate period of gloom

parts.note: nigh is an old word for near

indicators.note: ultimate points to the final letter of the word East

explanation.surface: The end of the Middle East's day brings darkness.
explanation.definitionFit: The hours of darkness are a time of gloom in the literal sense of dim light.

clue.text: Fever makes sailor cowardly at first

indicators.note: at first says the word for cowardly comes before the sailor

parts.note: yellow is slang for cowardly
Jack (Jack Tar) is a traditional name for a sailor

explanation.surface: Illness turns a sailor into a coward early on.
explanation.definitionFit: Yellow jack is an old name for yellow fever, from the quarantine flag ships flew.

clue.text: Attacking coterie with inside help

indicators.note: with inside says the help word goes within the coterie word

parts.note: a ring is a close group or clique, like a coterie
aid means help

explanation.surface: A clique attacks with the help of someone on the inside.
explanation.definitionFit: Raiding is making sudden attacks, so the participle matches attacking.

clue.text: Very good muddle with incoming Liberal lacking direction

parts.note: A1 means first-class, written AI in crosswords

indicators.note: with incoming says the Liberal letter enters the muddle word

parts.note: a mess is a muddle

explanation.surface: A political muddle as a Liberal arrives leaves things without purpose.
explanation.walkthrough: Very good = A1, with the figure 1 read as the letter I.
explanation.definitionFit: Something aimless has no goal, so it is without direction or purpose.

clue.text: Novelty drug makes one grow dull

parts.note: a fad is a passing novelty or craze
E is slang for the drug ecstasy

explanation.surface: A trendy new drug leaves a person sluggish.
explanation.definitionFit: To fade is to lose brightness or vigour, becoming dull.

clue.text: Inclined to suppress volume, by European instigator of rising

indicators.note: to suppress means to hold something down inside, so the inclined word holds the others

parts.note: leaning means inclined or tilted

explanation.surface: Someone tends to turn the volume down beside a European who starts an uprising.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rising' suggests a rebellion, but it is bread dough rising.
explanation.definitionFit: Leavening is yeast or another agent that makes dough rise, so it starts the rising.

clue.text: The dames help me out in town

indicators.note: out means the letters are put out of order and rearranged

explanation.surface: Ladies ask for help getting away from a place.
explanation.walkthrough: 'out' rearranges THEDAMESHELPME. HEMEL HEMPSTEAD is a town in Hertfordshire, north of London.
explanation.definitionFit: This is a Hertfordshire new town, so an example of a town.

clue.text: A knight set to become a messenger

parts.note: N is the chess notation for knight
to gel is to set firm

explanation.surface: A knight is about to be made a herald.
explanation.definitionFit: Angel comes from Greek angelos, meaning messenger, the role of heavenly envoys.

clue.text: Present one maiden to act as a go-between

parts.note: the Roman numeral I is one
M is the cricket abbreviation for a maiden over
to mediate is to act as a go-between

explanation.surface: Someone introduces a young woman to serve as an intermediary.
explanation.definitionFit: Immediate means current or happening now, the sense of present as an adjective.

clue.text: Commissioned writer and journalist are one and the same

parts.note: an author is a writer
saying one thing is another states they are identical, so the singular verb is
ED is short for editor, a journalist

explanation.surface: A hired writer and a journalist turn out to be the same person.
explanation.walkthrough: The wordplay reads as a sentence: the writer is the editor.
explanation.definitionFit: Authorised means sanctioned or officially empowered, which is what commissioned means.

clue.text: The sound of a top dog

indicators.note: the sound of says a word heard spoken gives the answer's spelling

parts.note: a peak is a top or summit

explanation.surface: A champion dog barks.
explanation.definitionFit: A peke is a Pekingese, a small breed of dog.

clue.text: Soldier and sailor at home in the course of work

indicators.note: in the course of puts the other pieces inside the work word, with a pun on career as course

parts.note: a career is one's work
AB, able-bodied seaman, is a sailor
in means at home

explanation.surface: A soldier and a sailor are at home during their working lives.
explanation.definitionFit: A carabineer was a soldier armed with a carbine, usually a cavalryman.

clue.text: Decorated beer vessel with external pipe?

definitions.text: Decorated beer vessel with external pipe?

parts.words: Decorated beer vessel with external pipe?
parts.note: a pottery mug modelled as a seated old man, often shown holding a pipe on its outside

explanation.surface: An ornamental tankard with a pipe attached to it.
explanation.walkthrough: The 'external pipe' sounds like plumbing, but it is the clay pipe held by the figure on the mug.
explanation.definitionFit: A toby jug is a decorated beer mug shaped like a stout man in a tricorn hat, sometimes smoking.

clue.text: Heavy bar odd guy shifted

indicators.note: shifted means the letters are moved around into a new order

explanation.surface: A strange man is moved out of a pub.
explanation.definitionFit: Heavy is slang for a hired muscleman, the job a bodyguard does.

clue.text: Servile son meets prodigal

parts.note: prodigal means lavish or wasteful

explanation.surface: An obedient son meets his spendthrift brother.
explanation.walkthrough: 'prodigal' recalls the parable's son, but it is an adjective here.
explanation.definitionFit: Slavish means servile, behaving like a slave.

clue.text: Former Italian leader, revolutionary about to be brought down

indicators.note: about means the revolutionary word goes around the other

parts.note: red is slang for a communist revolutionary
Il Duce was Mussolini's title

explanation.surface: Mussolini, with a rebel around him, is about to be toppled.
explanation.definitionFit: Reduced means lowered or cut, as brought down is.

clue.text: Coerce 13?

definitions.meaning: to force someone into doing something
the cross-reference points to the soldier answer, a cavalryman

explanation.definitionFit: A dragoon is a mounted soldier, and as a verb the word means to force by bullying.

clue.text: It may be put in place after the drill's gone through

definitions.text: It may be put in place after the drill's gone through

parts.words: It may be put in place after the drill's gone through
parts.note: describes a dentist filling a cavity once the drill has bored the tooth

explanation.surface: Something is fitted once a drilling operation is over.
explanation.walkthrough: The drill seems to be a builder's or a military drill, but it is the dentist's.
explanation.definitionFit: Amalgam is the mercury alloy dentists use to fill drilled teeth.

clue.text: Mythological Greek who helped her man with a clue

definitions.text: Mythological Greek who helped her man with a clue

parts.words: Mythological Greek who helped her man with a clue
parts.note: the Cretan princess gave Theseus a ball of thread, once called a clew, to escape the labyrinth

explanation.surface: A woman from legend assisted her lover by giving him a hint.
explanation.walkthrough: Clue is the old spelling of clew, a ball of thread, so it is not a puzzle hint.
explanation.definitionFit: In Greek myth this daughter of Minos guided Theseus out of the Minotaur's labyrinth with thread.

clue.text: Carrot, for one, needed to get a heavenly body

parts.note: a carrot is an example of veg

explanation.surface: Someone needs a carrot to reach a star.
explanation.definitionFit: Vega is a bright star in the constellation Lyra.

clue.text: Services required, otherwise cities fail

indicators.note: otherwise means the letters are arranged in another way

explanation.surface: Unless amenities are provided, cities collapse.
explanation.definitionFit: Facilities are the amenities or services provided in a place.

clue.text: Charlie and I meeting Mark about lunchtime

indicators.note: about means the mark word goes around the time

parts.note: a dot is a small mark
one o'clock, lunchtime, written as the Roman numeral I

explanation.surface: Charlie and I meet Mark at around lunchtime.
explanation.walkthrough: Charlie is British slang for a fool, not a name here.
explanation.definitionFit: Charlie is informal British for a fool, so a synonym of idiot.

clue.text: The man to lead some of Hitler's bully boys

definitions.text: The man to lead some of Hitler's bully boys

indicators.note: to lead puts the man word in front

parts.note: he refers to a man
the SS were the Nazi paramilitary corps

explanation.surface: A man is chosen to command a group of Nazi thugs.
explanation.walkthrough: Rudolf Hess was Hitler's deputy, so the whole clue describes him.
explanation.definitionFit: Rudolf Hess, Deputy Fuhrer, was a senior leader among the Nazis.

clue.text: Business arrangement offered by letter

parts.note: a letter here is a landlord who lets property, offering a tenure for a fixed term

explanation.surface: A deal is proposed by post.
explanation.walkthrough: 'letter' suggests correspondence, but it is someone who lets.
explanation.definitionFit: Leasehold is a form of tenure granted by a landlord under a lease.

clue.text: A particular typesize is chosen

definitions.meaning: a small typewriter type size, twelve characters to the inch
the chosen few, the select best

explanation.definitionFit: Elite names both a typewriter typeface size and a select group.

clue.text: Went to bits of tidiest garden that needed work

indicators.note: needed work says the letters must be worked over into a new order

explanation.surface: A neat garden fell apart because it needed attention.
explanation.definitionFit: Disintegrated means broke apart into fragments.
